MAINLINE-024, the film sag charged as lift. QUESTIONABLE. Not a certification. The filed film card is not rewritten.

The charged sphere has radius s on the triangle inradius. The crown is 0.0868487001771 m at s 2.04 m and 0.127718676731 m at s 3 m, against the note's about 0.087 m and 0.13 m. The mean is 0.503624902308 of the crown. Lift lost is 64.1580396987 kg at 2.04 m and 94.3500583804 kg at 3 m, against about 64 kg and 94 kg. At s 2 m the loss is 62.9000389203 kg. At s 4 m it is 125.800077841 kg.

A sphere through the vertices crowns at 0.374346974907 m at s 2.04 m and would cost 283.797315897 kg. It is shown and not charged.

The lightest system on s 2 to 4 m is Zylon HM 0/90 at s 2 m: film 107.550010269 kg plus lift loss 62.9000389203 kg, together 170.450049189 kg. Crown over thickness is 1551.98370605 at every bay, because both scale with s. Metallised mass is still unknown. The total is above 97.515 kg. Kapton HN plus that lift is 1537.72835156 kg at s 2 m.

Thickness follows s, so the film factor is 1. At that bay the briefed least factor is 1, governing film. Global is 1.00040754097. Closure equals the lift. Yield, Euler, local and Perry times sqrt(3) leave the least at 1, still film. The highest briefed factor on s 2 to 4 m is 1 at s 2 m. This does not replace the 011b scan.
